ImgCraft

The ImgCraft app, an unofficial, lightweight Android frontend for Imgur.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://brnl-claude.github.io/imgcraft-site/fdroid/repo
